title: 第181章 多宝 六耳快到碗里来第180章 秦三藏 你们可能识得哪个才是真的六耳
slug: 从车迟国开始布局西游
lines: 按照规矩他们在到达南天门的时候应该让守门的天兵天将到凌霄宝殿进行通报的，可是现在这两只猴子分明是打出了火气，怎么可能老老实实的等待天兵天将去通传？
两人一路打斗直接就打上了凌霄宝殿。
昊天此时正在大殿上进行朝会，看见两只六耳猕猴未经通传就闯了进来忍不住皱起了眉头。
原本他还想申斥一番，但是考虑到六耳到底是佛门的人他还是忍了下来。
太白金星看出了昊天内心的不喜，便充当起了昊天的嘴替：“六耳你好大的胆！这样冲进凌霄宝殿成何体统？”
六耳连忙开口：“昊天大帝还有各位仙官明鉴！俺六耳实在是事出有因，俺一心一意护送着秦三藏西行，谁知道竟有这精怪幻化成俺的样貌，俺今天是来是想请天庭大能帮忙辩一下真假还俺六耳一个公道的！”
孙悟空也开口道：“玉帝老儿，俺才是真的六耳，他分明就是假冒的！”
孙悟空一出口昊天、太白金星等一众仙神瞬间就知道了他的跟脚。
这货绝对是五百年前大闹天宫的孙悟空！
虽说他们分辨出来了，可是他们却不能说出来。
毕竟谁都知道孙悟空跟截教有着说不清道不明的关系，万一戳破了截教来天庭找麻烦那就麻烦了。
截教可是有两尊圣人级别的强者的，准圣更是数不胜数，他们天庭哪里是对手？
昊天直接给太白金星使了一个眼色，太白金星瞬间了然。
于是太白金星笑呵呵的开口道：“六耳，我天庭属实没有什么分辨真假的宝贝，若要分辨真假还请另寻他出吧!"
六耳却不走，伸手指了指昊天：“胡说！昊天大帝明明有一面昊天镜，那镜子便有分辨真假的作用！”
昊天脸色一黑，心里暗骂这六耳猕猴不晓事。
明眼人都能看出来天庭不想管这事，你还死皮赖脸的让天庭出手，真是讨厌！
不过他昊天到底还是要些面皮的，既然昊天镜的作用六耳知道了他也只好拿出来了。
只见他一挥衣袖直接将昊天镜给祭了出来：“昊天镜在此，你们自行分辨吧！”
此时此刻他满心祈祷孙悟空别被昊天镜给照出来，否则天庭的麻烦就大了！
昊天镜被亮出来的瞬间，孙悟空便走上前去，直接站在那昊天镜前面。
只见孙悟空身上浮现出一丝道韵，原本即将浮现出他本体的镜面只荡漾了便直接恢复了正常。
昊天见状连忙开口道：“嗯，这是真的六耳猕猴无疑。”
六耳猕猴愣住了，他是六耳猕猴？那我是谁？
孙悟空看着六耳猕猴：“妖怪！现在事实已经很明显了，你还不速速现出原形！？”
六耳猕猴连忙开口：“你定是使了什么手段！昊天镜没有照出你的原形难道就能照出我的吗？”
话音落下六耳猕猴也是直接来到了昊天镜的前面，昊天镜依旧是没有什么反应。
昊天见状直接开口：“好了，既然昊天镜没能直接分辨出你们谁是真的六耳猕猴那你们便前往其他大能那分辨吧！”
六耳猕猴略一思索开口道：“那咱们就去灵山，佛门定能分辨出你我谁是真的，你可敢与我走上一趟？”
content_en:
According to the rules, when they arrived at the Nantianmen, they should have the heavenly soldiers and generals guarding the gate go to the Lingxiao Palace to report. But now these two monkeys were clearly angry. How could they just wait for the heavenly soldiers and generals to report?
The two fought all the way to the Lingxiao Palace.
Haotian was conducting a court meeting in the main hall at this time, and couldn't help but frown when he saw two six-eared macaques barging in without being informed.
Originally, he wanted to reprimand him, but considering that Liu Er was a Buddhist, he endured it.
Taibai Jinxing saw Haotian's inner displeasure, so he acted as Haotian's mouthpiece: "Liu'er, you are so brave! How unbecoming is it to rush into the Lingxiao Palace like this?"
Liu Er hurriedly spoke: "Emperor Haotian and all the Immortal Officials Ming Jian! My Liu Er really had a reason for everything. I escorted Qin Sanzang to the west wholeheartedly. Who would have known that this spirit would turn into my appearance? I came here today to ask the great master of heaven to help me debate the authenticity and give justice to Liu Er!"
Sun Wukong also said: "Jade Emperor, I am the real six ears, he is obviously a fake!"
As soon as Sun Wukong said Haotian, Taibai Jinxing and other immortals knew his whereabouts instantly.
This guy is definitely Sun Wukong who caused trouble in the Heavenly Palace five hundred years ago!
Although they recognized it, they could not speak it out.
After all, everyone knows that Sun Wukong has an unclear relationship with Jie Jiao. If Jie Jiao is revealed and comes to heaven to cause trouble, it will be troublesome.
Jiejiao has two saint-level experts, and there are countless quasi-sages. Who are their opponents in heaven?
Haotian winked directly at Taibaijinxing, and Taibaijinxing understood instantly.
So Taibai Jinxing said with a smile: "Liuer, I really don't have any treasures in heaven to distinguish the true from the false. If you want to distinguish the true from the false, please find someone else!"
Liu Er did not leave, and pointed at Haotian: "Nonsense! Emperor Haotian obviously has a Haotian mirror, and that mirror can distinguish between true and false!"
Haotian's face darkened, and he secretly scolded the six-eared macaque for being ignorant.
Anyone with a discerning eye can see that Heaven doesn't want to take care of this matter, but you still shamelessly ask Heaven to take action. It's really annoying!
But he, Haotian, still wanted to have some respect. Now that Liu Er knew the function of the Haotian Mirror, he had no choice but to take it out.
I saw him waving his sleeves and directly offering the Haotian Mirror: "The Haotian Mirror is here, you can distinguish it by yourselves!"
At this moment, he prayed with all his heart that Sun Wukong would not be reflected in the Haotian Mirror, otherwise there would be big trouble in heaven!
The moment the Haotian Mirror was revealed, Sun Wukong stepped forward and stood directly in front of the Haotian Mirror.
I saw a trace of Tao Yun emerging from Sun Wukong's body, and the mirror that was about to reveal his body only rippled and returned to normal.
Upon seeing this, Haotian quickly said: "Well, there is no doubt that this is a real six-eared macaque."
The six-eared macaque was stunned. Is he a six-eared macaque? So who am I?
Sun Wukong looked at the six-eared macaque: "Monster! The facts are obvious now, why don't you show your true colors quickly!?"
The six-eared macaque said quickly: "You must have used some trick! If the Haotian Mirror doesn't reveal your true form, how can it reveal mine?"
After saying this, the six-eared macaque came directly in front of Haotian Mirror, but Haotian Mirror still showed no reaction.
Seeing this, Haotian said directly: "Okay, since the Haotian Mirror can't directly tell which of you is the real six-eared macaque, then you can go to other powerful people to tell the difference!"
The six-eared macaque thought for a while and said: "Then let's go to Lingshan. The Buddhists will definitely be able to tell who is real between you and me. Do you dare to go with me?"
title_en: Chapter 181 Duobao Six Ears Come to the bowl Chapter 180 Qin Sanzang You may know which one is the real Six Ears
